description: Reads the casting: status, the opening message, each creator and their state (found, contacted, replied, signed, filming, posted, checked, paid, passed) with our first message to them, each video with views and cost per 1,000 views, totals, and needs_person (what a human must do next, if anything). Read only. Results take days, not minutes: check once a day, do not poll. When needs_person names a deadline (a checked video counts as approved 48 hours after its check), act that same day, or set notify_url to be told.

casting_id.description: The casting id that cast returned.

casting_token.description: The casting_token that cast returned when it was called without an API key. Not needed with an API key.

name: get_results
title: Results of a casting
